instructions: Homework template. Fill this in for a workplace agent of your choice. Define each tool the agent may use, and the safety rules that govern it. A good schema is precise: the description is what the model reads to decide whether to call the tool, and 'requires_human_approval' is your main safety lever.

tools.name: example_search_orders
tools.description: Look up an order by its ID and return its status and total. Read-only.
tools.returns: order status and total, or 'not found'

safety_rules: Example: never call a money-moving tool without explicit human approval.
Example: if a tool returns an error twice, stop and ask the user.
Example: never act on personal data the user is not authorised to access.
